ITEM 1 | Two thin strips of cooked meat, amber-brown with darker edges, glossy and slightly translucent, with crisp curled edges and a slightly chewy look; each strip about 8 to 9 cm long and 1 cm wide, lying diagonally across the upper left of the plate | 8
ITEM 2 | Cubed pieces of soft, juicy fruit with pinkish-red flesh and pale white rind edges, matte with a slight moist sheen; cubes about 1.5 cm per side, clustered center-right of the plate | 25
ITEM 3 | Small dark blue to near-black round berries with a matte, slightly waxy skin, scattered in a loose band around the fruit cubes and under the meat strips; each about 1 cm across, roughly 15 berries | 10
ITEM 4 | One bright red, bumpy-surfaced small berry with a matte finish, about 2 cm across, sitting near the lower center of the fruit cluster | 3
